The strict test therefore isolates runtime survival plus durable close more cleanly than end-of-turn rearm designs.
A later wake does not retroactively prove a clean close; both scheduler and close evidence are required.
The prior under-target run demonstrated workload-generator insufficiency, not a runtime ceiling.
The expanded 72-unit declaration provides >2x the prior exhausted unit count while preserving boundedness.
Workload heterogeneity is retained by six unit families rather than one repetitive write loop.
The next strict class remains 16m only after this 14m retry reaches target and closes durably.
No production cap can be promoted from this exploratory pass even if successful.
